sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Air Hockey Glow: 2 Players is an air hockey game where two players compete against each other. The objective is simple: hit the puck into your opponent's goal while preventing them from scoring on you. The gameplay is fast-paced and action-packed, requiring quick reflexes and strategic thinking.
          Players can move their mallet by dragging their finger across the screen, with the speed of the drag determining the speed of the mallet. The puck can be placed on the screen by tapping on it, allowing for precise control over its trajectory.
          As players progress through the game, they'll encounter various obstacles and challenges, including power-ups and special effects that can alter the gameplay in exciting ways. The game also features a variety of game modes, including multiplayer and single-player modes.
